rights.title: Know your rights
rights.intro: General information about Indian labour law. It is not legal advice.
rights.hours.title: Working hours
rights.hours.body: Normally at most 9 hours a day and 48 hours a week, with a break after 5 hours of work.
rights.overtime.title: Overtime pay
rights.overtime.body: Extra hours are paid at twice your normal rate.
rights.rest.title: Weekly rest
rights.rest.body: You get at least one day off every week.
rights.equal.title: Equal pay
rights.equal.body: Women and men doing the same work must get the same pay.
rights.safety.title: Safety gear
rights.safety.body: Helmets, gloves, harnesses and other safety gear must be given to you free.
rights.pf.title: PF and ESI
rights.pf.body: If you are covered, your employer also pays into your provident fund and health insurance. Your payslip shows your share.
rights.harassment.title: Harassment
rights.harassment.body: Workplaces with 10 or more workers must have a committee for complaints of sexual harassment.
rights.help.title: Where to get help
rights.help.labour: Your state's labour department handles wage and safety complaints.
